notes.title: Sophistry Playtest is Live Now!
notes.notes:
Here's what's included in this playtest:

[list]
[*] Tutorial: Learn the ropes and get familiar with the mechanics.
[*] Bot Match: Challenge yourself against an AI opponent.
[*] Multiplayer Online: Test your skills against real players in exciting matches!
[/list]

We'd love to hear your feedback, bug reports, and anything else you'd like to share. Join our Discord community to discuss, plan matches, and contribute to the game's development!

🔗 https://discord.gg/hJyAAKxt

Happy playing, and thank you for helping us improve Sophistry!

notes.title: Join the Playtest of Sophistry LCG 0.1!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=M3vZi3lMm1s;full][/previewyoutube]

Sophistry LCG is preparing to release its first Beta test. Sign up to be one of the first to win Debates in this new card game.

[list]
[*] Play with 50 Idea Cards and explore crazy synergies! More cards are coming in future updates.
[*] Choose from 15 different Philosophers.
[*] Play against real players—multiplayer is available now!
[*] Adapt to each game with 2 different win conditions: answer the debate question or convince the audience, even without being right!
[/list]

Want to know how to play before trying out? No problem, watch our How to Play video! 
Sign up now to be a part of the exciting Beta!
